sentences.en: One of the most famous cases of extinction is that of a bird known as the dodo.
sentences.zh: 最著名的灭绝案例之一，是一种名为渡渡鸟的鸟类。

sentences.en: In fact there's even a saying in English, 'as dead as the dodo'，used to refer to something which no longer exists.
sentences.zh: 事实上，英语中甚至有一句俗语：‘像渡渡鸟一样死透了’，用来指代某物已不复存在。

sentences.en: But for many centuries the dodo was alive and well, although it could only be found in one place, the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 但在许多世纪里，渡渡鸟一直生机勃勃，尽管它仅存于一个地方——印度洋中的毛里求斯岛。

sentences.en: It was a very large bird, about one metre tall, and over the centuries it had lost the ability to fly, but it survived happily under the trees that covered the island.
sentences.zh: 它是一种体型非常大的鸟类，约一米高；经过数百年演化，它已丧失飞行能力，但曾愉快地栖息在覆盖全岛的树林之下。

sentences.en: Then in the year 1507 the first Portuguese ships stopped at the island.
sentences.zh: 1507年，首批葡萄牙船只停靠该岛。

sentences.en: The sailors were carrying spices back to Europe, and found the island a convenient stopping place where they could stock up with food and water for the rest of the voyage, but they didn't settle on Mauritius.
sentences.zh: 水手们正将香料运回欧洲，发现该岛是航程中一处便利的停靠点，可供他们补充食物与淡水，但他们并未在毛里求斯定居。

sentences.en: However, in 1638 the Dutch arrived and set up a colony there.
sentences.zh: 然而，1638年荷兰人抵达并在那里建立了殖民地。

sentences.en: These first human inhabitants of the island found the dodo birds a convenient source of meat, although not everyone liked the taste.
sentences.zh: 这些岛上最早的人类居民发现渡渡鸟是方便的肉食来源，尽管并非所有人都喜欢其味道。

sentences.en: It's hard to get an accurate description of what the dodo actually looked like.
sentences.zh: 人们很难获得关于渡渡鸟真实外貌的准确描述。

sentences.en: We do have some written records from sailors, and a few pictures, but we don't know how reliable these are.
sentences.zh: 我们确实拥有一些来自水手的文字记录及少量图画，但尚不清楚这些资料的可靠性如何。

sentences.en: The best-known picture is a Dutch painting in which the bird appears to be extremely fat, but this may not be accurate — an Indian painting done at the same time shows a much thinner bird.
sentences.zh: 最广为人知的图画是一幅荷兰油画，画中渡渡鸟显得异常肥胖，但这可能并不准确——同一时期一幅印度绘画所呈现的则是一只瘦得多的鸟。

sentences.en: Although attempts were made to preserve the bodies of some of the birds, no complete specimen survives.
sentences.zh: 尽管曾有人尝试保存部分渡渡鸟的尸体，却无一具完整标本留存至今。

sentences.en: In the early 17th century four dried parts of a bird were known to exist- of these, three have disappeared, so only one example of soft tissue from the dodo survives, a dodo head.
sentences.zh: 17世纪早期，已知有四件风干的渡渡鸟身体部位标本；其中三件已消失，目前仅存一件软组织标本，即一只渡渡鸟的头部。

sentences.en: Bones have also been found, but there's only one complete skeleton in existence.
sentences.zh: 此外也发现了一些骨骼，但现存完整的骨架仅有一具。

sentences.en: This single dodo skeleton has recently been the subject of scientific research which suggests that many of the earlier beliefs about dodos may have been incorrect.
sentences.zh: 这具唯一的渡渡鸟骨架最近成为科学研究的对象，研究结果表明，此前关于渡渡鸟的许多观点可能是错误的。

sentences.en: For example, early accounts of the birds mention how slow and clumsy it was, but scientists now believe the bird's strong knee joints would have made it capable of movement which was not slow, but actually quite fast.
sentences.zh: 例如，早期文献曾描述这种鸟行动迟缓笨拙，但科学家如今认为，其强健的膝关节使其运动能力并非迟缓，反而相当迅捷。

sentences.en: In fact, one 17th century sailor wrote that he found the birds hard to catch.
sentences.zh: 事实上，一名17世纪的水手曾写道，他发现这些鸟很难捕捉。

sentences.en: It's true that the dodo's small wings wouldn't have allowed it to leave the ground, but the scientists suggest that these were probably employed for balance while going over uneven ground.
sentences.zh: 诚然，渡渡鸟的小翅膀无法使其离地起飞，但科学家推测，这些翅膀很可能用于在崎岖地面上保持身体平衡。

sentences.en: Another group of scientists carried out analysis of the dodo's skull.
sentences.zh: 另一组科学家对渡渡鸟的头骨进行了分析。

sentences.en: They found that the reports of the lack of intelligence of the dodo were not borne out by their research, which suggested the bird's brain was not small, but average in size.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，有关渡渡鸟缺乏智力的说法并未得到研究支持；研究显示，其脑部大小并非偏小，而是处于平均水平。

sentences.en: In fact, in relation to its body size, it was similar to that of the pigeon, which is known to be a highly intelligent bird.
sentences.zh: 事实上，就其体型比例而言，其脑部大小与鸽子相近——而鸽子是公认的高智商鸟类。

sentences.en: The researchers also found that the structure of the bird's skull suggested that one sense which was particularly well-developed was that of smell.
sentences.zh: 研究人员还发现，该鸟头骨结构表明，其嗅觉这一感官尤为发达。

sentences.en: So the dodo may also have been particularly good at locating ripe fruit and other food in the island's thick vegetation.
sentences.zh: 因此，渡渡鸟或许特别擅长在岛屿茂密的植被中寻找成熟果实及其他食物。

sentences.en: Audioscripts So it looks as if the dodo was better able to survive and defend itself than was originally believed.
sentences.zh: 听力原文：因此，渡渡鸟似乎比原先所认为的更具生存与自卫能力。

sentences.en: Yet less than 200 years after Europeans first arrived on the island, they had become extinct.
sentences.zh: 然而，在欧洲人首次登陆该岛不到200年后，渡渡鸟便已灭绝。

sentences.en: So what was the reason for this?
sentences.zh: 那么，造成这一结果的原因究竟是什么？

sentences.en: For a long time, it was believed that the dodos were hunted to extinction, but scientists now believe the situation was more complicated than this.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，人们一直认为渡渡鸟是因被过度捕猎而灭绝的，但科学家如今认为实际情况比这更为复杂。

sentences.en: Another factor may have been the new species brought to the island by the sailors.
sentences.zh: 另一个可能因素是水手们带入该岛的新物种。

sentences.en: These included dogs, which would have been a threat to the dodos, and also monkeys, which ate the fruit that was the main part of the dodos' diet.
sentences.zh: 这些物种包括对渡渡鸟构成威胁的狗，以及以果实为食的猴子——而果实正是渡渡鸟的主要食物。

sentences.en: These were brought to the island deliberately, but the ships also brought another type of creature- rats, which came to land from the ships and rapidly overran the island.
sentences.zh: 这些动物是人为引入岛上的，但船只还带来了另一种生物——老鼠；它们从船上登陆，并迅速遍布全岛。

sentences.en: These upset the ecology of the island, not just the dodos but other species too.
sentences.zh: 这些老鼠扰乱了岛屿的生态平衡，不仅影响渡渡鸟，也波及其他物种。

sentences.en: However, they were a particular danger to the dodos because they consumed their eggs, and since each dodo only laid one at a time, this probably had a devastating effect on populations.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们对渡渡鸟尤其危险，因为它们会吞食渡渡鸟的蛋；而每只渡渡鸟一次仅产一枚蛋，这很可能对种群数量造成毁灭性打击。

sentences.en: However, we now think that probably the main cause of the birds' extinction was not the introduction of non-native species, but the introduction of agriculture.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们现在认为，导致渡渡鸟灭绝的主因可能并非外来物种的引入，而是农业的引入。

sentences.en: This meant that the forest that had once covered all the island, and that had provided a perfect home for the dodo, was cut down so that crops such as sugar could be grown.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，曾经覆盖全岛、为渡渡鸟提供理想栖息地的森林被砍伐殆尽，以便种植甘蔗等作物。

sentences.en: So although the dodo had survived for thousands of years, suddenly it was gone.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管渡渡鸟已存活数千年，却突然彻底消失了。
